title: BEYOND CONSENSUS: MITIGATING THE AGREEABLE NESS BIAS IN LLM JUDGE EVALUATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs as judges on an open-ended code feedback task by comparing their validation predictions against human-annotated ground truth, specifically quantifying the asymmetry between high True Positive Rates (TPR) and low True Negative Rates (TNR) to measure their tendency to accept invalid outputs.
